title: Inviting People: Yes and No
summary: In this lesson, you will learn how to invite friends to do things. You will also practice how to say yes or no politely.

sections.p: When you want to ask someone to do something with you, use 'Would you like to...' or 'Do you want to...'. These are very common and polite ways to invite a friend to a movie, dinner, or a party. Always smile and be friendly when you ask!

ex.en: Would you like to come to my party?
ex.mean: Asking someone to join your party politely

ex.en: Do you want to grab a coffee tomorrow?
ex.mean: Asking a friend to get coffee together

sections.p: When someone invites you and you are free, you should accept happily. Say thank you first! You can use phrases like 'I'd love to' or 'That sounds great' to show that you are excited about their invitation.

ex.mean: Saying yes and asking for the time

sections.p: Sometimes you cannot go. When you need to say no, be very polite so you do not hurt your friend's feelings. Always start by thanking them. Then, give a simple reason, like being busy, and say sorry.

ex.en: I'm sorry, I'm busy that day.
ex.mean: Saying no because you have other plans

ex.en: Thank you, but I can't make it.
ex.mean: Polite way to refuse an invitation

tip: Always say 'Thank you' before you accept or refuse an invitation. It shows that you appreciate your friend asking you!

quiz.ask: Choose the best way to invite a friend.
quiz.en: ___ you like to go to the cinema tonight?

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word to complete the phrase.
Select the polite way to say no.
Choose the correct phrase to show excitement.
Choose the correct response to a refusal.
